name: lem-hcb4-canonical-gram
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb4-canonical-gram — Canonical corner Gram estimate: there are universal C_J < infinity and e_J > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_J, every n >= 1, and every Z in either special P,Q corner satisfy (1-C_J*e)||Z|| <= ||J_n(Z)|| <= (1+C_J*e)||Z||.
